title: Pragmatics
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the central authority behind the creation of the textual meaning that can be inferred from the text."
The implied author is the central authority behind the creation of the textual meaning that can be inferred from the text.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that are (a) self-referential i.e. the verb refers to what the speaker of the utterance is doing and (b) self-verifying i.e. they contain their own truth and are non-falsifiable."

Metalinguistic performatives are those that are (a) self-referential i.e. the verb refers to what the speaker of the utterance is doing and (b) self-verifying i.e. they contain their own truth and are non-falsifiable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those implicatures that arise regardless of the context in which the utterance occurs (Grundy, 2008)."
Generalised implicatures are those implicatures that arise regardless of the context in which the utterance occurs (Grundy, 2008).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to direct the witnesses."
Commands are used to direct the witnesses.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most powerful and can interrupt at will or speak at any time during the proceedings."
The judge is the most powerful and can interrupt at will or speak at any time during the proceedings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the positive self-image of a person which includes the desire to be appreciated or approved of."
Positive face is the positive self-image of a person which includes the desire to be appreciated or approved of.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to refer or to point at things while reference deals with the reflexive nature of language."
Deixis focuses on how language is used to refer or to point at things while reference deals with the reflexive nature of language.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that are produced by more than one person e.g. a communiqué from a summit or a conference, a report of a committee and a verdict of a jury."
Group performatives are those that are produced by more than one person e.g. a communiqué from a summit or a conference, a report of a committee and a verdict of a jury.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a non-linguistic act performed as a consequence of the locutionary and illocutionary acts (Coulthard, 1977)."
A perlocutionary act is a non-linguistic act performed as a consequence of the locutionary and illocutionary acts (Coulthard, 1977).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a noun phrase, a referring expression that refers to the Prime Minister and helps us to understand the behaviour of the character."
The italicised words is a noun phrase, a referring expression that refers to the Prime Minister and helps us to understand the behaviour of the character.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a theory that proposes that only relevance is needed in order for a hearer to understand the meaning of a speaker's utterance."
Relevance theory is a theory that proposes that only relevance is needed in order for a hearer to understand the meaning of a speaker's utterance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that are derived from contextual clues."
Conversational implicatures are those that are derived from contextual clues.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that are highly culturally dependent and they occur in ritual or very formal events."
Ritual performatives are those that are highly culturally dependent and they occur in ritual or very formal events.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability of a person to exercise his or her will in a social action, even against the will of other people (Weber, 1947)."
Power is the ability of a person to exercise his or her will in a social action, even against the will of other people (Weber, 1947).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a government official who is in the hearing to defend himself."
The hearer is a government official who is in the hearing to defend himself.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with how we produce and understand everyday use of language (Grundy, 2008)."
Pragmatics is concerned with how we produce and understand everyday use of language (Grundy, 2008).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to urge the receiver to act promptly."
The directive act is used to urge the receiver to act promptly.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a multicultural and multiethnic society, thus, it is imperative that interactants be prepared for the kinds of principles that need to be understood in such interactions."
Nigeria is a multicultural and multiethnic society, thus, it is imperative that interactants be prepared for the kinds of principles that need to be understood in such interactions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the type of referring expression which refers to a referent that has to be chosen by the addressers from a class of referents."
An indefinite reference is the type of referring expression which refers to a referent that has to be chosen by the addressers from a class of referents.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of pragmatic phenomena in different cultures in order to set up comparison and predict possible misunderstandings (Archer et al, 2012)."
Cross-cultural communication is the study of pragmatic phenomena in different cultures in order to set up comparison and predict possible misunderstandings (Archer et al, 2012).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the prominence on a syllable which is used to highlight a part of a sentence to match informativeness."
Pitch is the prominence on a syllable which is used to highlight a part of a sentence to match informativeness.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process through which a hearer works out the meaning of an utterance from what is stated and unstated using the hearer's general knowledge and context."
Inference is a process through which a hearer works out the meaning of an utterance from what is stated and unstated using the hearer's general knowledge and context.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the investigation of 'interpersonal aspects of communication and interaction' from a pragmatic perspective (Haugh, Kadar & Mills, 2013:2)."
Interpersonal Pragmatics is concerned with the investigation of 'interpersonal aspects of communication and interaction' from a pragmatic perspective (Haugh, Kadar & Mills, 2013:2).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to 'explain the reason for a message in discourse'."
Elaborative markers are used to 'explain the reason for a message in discourse'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a general situational prototype which is instantiated through individual pragmatic acts or practs."
A pragmeme is a general situational prototype which is instantiated through individual pragmatic acts or practs.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the relationship that holds between a linguistic expression (i.e. a name) and what it stands for in the real world (i.e. an object or idea)."
Reference is the relationship that holds between a linguistic expression (i.e. a name) and what it stands for in the real world (i.e. an object or idea).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important aspect of pragmatics that should be studied in human interactions, particularly as the world has become a global village."
Intercultural pragmatics is an important aspect of pragmatics that should be studied in human interactions, particularly as the world has become a global village.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of writing that is transmitted by electronic means (Herring, 2001)."
CMC is a form of writing that is transmitted by electronic means (Herring, 2001).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a shared cognitive environment that is manifest to two or more individuals at a given time."
A mutual cognitive environment is a shared cognitive environment that is manifest to two or more individuals at a given time.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of representatives of different groups in the process of interacting with each other to see how differences are negotiated (Archer et al, 2012)."
Intercultural communication is the study of representatives of different groups in the process of interacting with each other to see how differences are negotiated (Archer et al, 2012).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a set of verbal routines and strategies which are used to enhance co-operative interaction by establishing and maintaining personal relationships."
Politeness is defined as a set of verbal routines and strategies which are used to enhance co-operative interaction by establishing and maintaining personal relationships.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the data that is collected without the intervention of the researcher."
Authentic data is the data that is collected without the intervention of the researcher.
fib: ______ is an aspect of pragmatics that focuses on the pragmatic processes that take place in the production and interpretation of a literary text.
Literary pragmatics
Literary pragmatics is an aspect of pragmatics that focuses on the pragmatic processes that take place in the production and interpretation of a literary text.
______ is used for singular you, younger and close associates while eyin is used for plural you, superiors, older and distant persons.
Iwo
Iwo is used for singular you, younger and close associates while eyin is used for plural you, superiors, older and distant persons.
______ is a concept in pragmatics that deals with implied meaning.
Implicature
Implicature is a concept in pragmatics that deals with implied meaning.
______ are used by the dominant participants in order to secure a particular response (Farinde, 2008).
Interactional controllers
Interactional controllers are used by the dominant participants in order to secure a particular response (Farinde, 2008).

Ethnographers
Ethnographers are concerned with the writing of „rules of speaking‟ for a particular group of speakers.
______ are the largest units for which one can discover linguistic structures and these occur in speech situations which are non-verbal contexts.
Speech events

______ is an area of phonology that can have pragmatic meaning while nonverbal language can be used to express implied meaning.
Intonation

______ is concerned with the analysis of the language of law and other related issues.
Legal discourse

Face Constituting Theory (FCT)
Face Constituting Theory
FCT

______ are used to capture conversational features such as pauses, interruptions and repetitions.
Transcription conventions
Transcription conventions are used to capture conversational features such as pauses, interruptions and repetitions.
______ are those that are 'derived directly from the meaning of the words in use' (Archer et al, 2012).
Conventional implicatures
Conventional implicatures are those that are 'derived directly from the meaning of the words in use' (Archer et al, 2012).
______ is a metaphor for saying that a person is promiscuous.
She's a dog
She's a dog is a metaphor for saying that a person is promiscuous.
______ are used to direct the listener to something interesting and important.
Pauses
Pauses are used to direct the listener to something interesting and important.
______ are used to point at things in a particular context.
Deixis addresses how words
Deixis addresses how words are used to point at things in a particular context.

______ is the grammatical encoding of features of a speech event which include the role or status of participants, the activities being discussed and the spatio- temporal context (Archer et al, 2012).
Deixis

Deixis is the grammatical encoding of features of a speech event which include the role or status of participants, the activities being discussed and the spatio- temporal context (Archer et al, 2012).

Internal political communication

Internal political communication refers to all forms of discourse that concern the functioning of politics within political institutions such as governmental bodies, parties or other political organisations.
______ is concerned with the ways in which language is manipulated for specific political effects within different political contexts.
Political discourse

Metadiscoursal comments

______ are those that arise out of an extra-contextual association. where the immediate understanding of the context of use is important.
Particularised implicatures

______ are concerned with conditions on the occurrence of certain forms of behaviour.
Regulative rules

Negative face

______ refers to the functions as discourse acts while pragmatics refers to it as speech or pragmatic acts.
Discourse analysis

Computer-mediated discourse (CMD)
Computer-mediated discourse
CMD

generic reference

Elicited data

Ethnography of communication

individual's cognitive environment

co-text
